summary: Adversarial testing of the S2 spec-review gate found no contract defect. The new suite test_s2_adversarial.sh has 96 checks, and all pass. Ten broken checker copies each fail at least one probe. Seven nonblocking items stay open.
phase: Phase S2: The measure-spec-review orchestrator role
nonblocking_findings: NETZERO [skills/measure-orchestrator/scripts/measure_interphase_checks.py:636] The scope check compares two trees, not the commits between them. A commit that adds src/tmp.py and a later commit that removes it give exit 0 and PASS. The plan contract (plan.md:121) prescribes this git diff command, so the code obeys the plan. Spec story S2 says 'no commit outside measure/runs/'. The role has edit permission only in measure/runs/**, so this is a second line of defense. Route to the user as a CONFIRM item; a fix (git log --name-only --no-renames) needs a plan amendment. Severity: Major.

QUADRATIC [skills/measure-orchestrator/scripts/measure_interphase_checks.py:82,356] SPEC_REVIEW_FINDING_RE.fullmatch takes quadratic time on a finding with many ': ' pairs and a trailing LF. Measured on this host: 2000 pairs 0.10 s, 5000 pairs 0.40 s, 10000 pairs 1.46 s. Thus a finding of about 200 KB stops the gate for minutes. The gate does not pass falsely; it waits. The author of the JSON is the spec-review agent, not an attacker. A length check of each finding before the regex, or the check for line breaks before the regex, removes the risk. Severity: Nit.

TRAILSEP [skills/measure-orchestrator/scripts/measure_interphase_checks.py:357] A finding that ends with one CR, VT, or U+2028 and has no second line passes, because str.splitlines() gives one item and '.' matches these characters. A second line after each separator fails, as the remediation requires. A description of one space ('F1 [Major] x:  ') also passes. Severity: Nit.

ZWSP [skills/measure-orchestrator/scripts/measure_interphase_checks.py:346] paraphrase.proposes of U+200B passes, because str.strip() keeps U+200B. Extra keys in paraphrase also pass. The strategy lists both as Report items. Severity: Nit.

TRACEBACK [skills/measure-orchestrator/scripts/measure_interphase_checks.py:121,381] Three inputs give a Python Traceback with exit 1: a file name with the byte 0xff below measure/runs/ (UnicodeDecodeError from git() with text=True), a result file with the bytes ff fe 00, and a folder as --result-file. The gate fails closed in each case. A valid commit with a non-UTF-8 file name in measure/runs/ thus fails the gate. The read_audit cases are older than this track. Severity: Nit.

PLANTEXT [measure/tracks/spec_review_gate_20261030/plan.md:121] The contract text still says that the block 'strips each output line' and calls git diff without -z. The code reads NUL-separated paths and does not strip them (remediation b955a3e). The plan records the remediation in a note under Task 2.2 (plan.md:157), but the contract sentence is stale. Update the contract sentence at the next plan edit. Severity: Nit.

ALIASCASE [skills/measure-orchestrator/scripts/measure_interphase_checks.py:493] '--role SPEC-REVIEW' gives exit 1 with 'unknown role', because ROLE_ALIASES is case-sensitive. This agrees with the other roles. Also, '--baseline -h' in the space form gives an argparse error with exit 2; the suite uses the form '--baseline=<value>'. Severity: Nit.
